data.name: Club Defenders
data.detailed_description:
Our music is under attack!

Alien invaders known as the Xilenz are trying to steal Earth’s music.

As an agent of TeeDee Corp, you must defend nightclubs around the world and stop the invasion.

Build towers, shape labyrinth defenses and fight alien waves using weapons, instruments and the power of music.

Fight. Build. Defend. All at Once.

When a new wave hits the club, players constantly jump between tasks:

  • build and upgrade towers and traps with unique attack patterns and powerful effects

  • fight on the frontlines using futuristic melee and ranged weapons

  • use instruments to boost defenses - or smash incoming aliens in close combat

  • unleash character abilities that can turn the tide of battle

  • keep the defense running by reloading towers and managing key systems

  • complete mission objectives while the attack continues

Strategy and action happen simultaneously, forcing players to constantly adapt as the pressure of incoming waves keeps rising.

Build the Maze Yourself

There are no predefined enemy paths.

Aliens move directly toward the objective - until you reshape the battlefield.

  • build towers and barriers to redirect enemies

  • create complex labyrinth defenses

  • trap enemies in deadly choke points

Every match creates a completely different battlefield.

Music Is Your Combat System

Four music genres power the entire game:

  • Pop – versatile and balanced

  • Rock – flames and area damage

  • HipHop – crowd control and slow effects

  • Electro – high energy and massive damage

Enemies may resist certain genres, so adapting your strategy is key.

4-Player Co-op

Play solo or team up with up to four players.

  • While alien waves attack from multiple directions, players must coordinate their actions, react to sudden threats and support each other when the defense begins to crumble.

  • When the pressure rises, communication and teamwork decide whether the club stands - or the Xilenz take over.

  • Playing solo? A small robot companion helps keep the defense running by assisting with important tasks.

data.short_description: Club Defenders is a co-op action tower defense game where music becomes humanity’s ultimate weapon. Build towers, control enemy paths and stop alien invasions inside vibrant nightclubs with weapons and instruments. Master four powerful music genres that shape every strategy and combat ability.

English*, German, French, Spanish - Spain
